verdict.rationale: Productboard automatically detects insights within feedback and links them to related feature ideas, showing native AI-generated insight surfacing inside the product, and the MCP server lets AI agents act on that data (prioritization, specs, initiatives). However, evidence is limited to marketing claims with no hands-on validation of insight quality or breadth of AI suggestions beyond feedback-to-feature linking. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of AI insight accuracy, broader AI-generated suggestions (e.g., roadmap prioritization, summarization) beyond feedback linking, and detail on how insights are surfaced in UI.
